title: RFC9009: add dissectors for DCO and DCO ACK packets, and update RPL Transit Information Option
description:
This merge request adds support for dissecting DCO (Destination Cleanup Object) and DCO ACK packets as specified in RFC 9009. Additionally, it introduces a new I flag in the Transit Information Option, which allows invalidating routes.
RFC9009 is related to RFC655: RPL - IPv6 Routing Protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks
Sample capture file for testing: [DCO-DCO-ACK-test.pcap](/uploads/ddaaa045ddc4b98da767ad3d8896df07/DCO-DCO-ACK-test.pcap)
